name: Kong Inc. (formerly Mashape)
origin_detail: Founded as Mashape, an API marketplace, by Italian founders Augusto Marietti, Marco Palladino and Michele Zonca, who moved the company to San Francisco. It open-sourced the Kong API gateway in 2015 and renamed itself Kong Inc. in 2017, later selling the marketplace.
openness_notes: Kong Gateway OSS is Apache-2.0 (built on NGINX/OpenResty); Kong Enterprise and the Konnect SaaS are proprietary, so it has been open core throughout. It donated its Kuma service mesh to CNCF. Any post-2024 change to how the OSS gateway is distributed is unverified.
robustness: Single-vendor gateway on top of community NGINX/OpenResty; Apache-2.0 core is forkable.
openness_effect_assessment: Not assessed: no sourced research was possible in this session.
key_takeaway: Draft only. Kong kept a stable Apache-2.0 open core with no core relicensing, monetized enterprise features and SaaS, and donated a secondary project (Kuma) to CNCF, a contrast with the database companies that relicensed their cores.
